# dsh-session-query-vector
A semantic session-search backend for DSH, backed by Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible `/v1/embeddings
session-search backend for DSH, backed by Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible `/v1/embeddings` endpoint.
DSH ships a SQLite full-text backend (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query-sqlite`) that answers "which s
ession contained this word". This package replaces it with a vector backend that answers "which sess
ion was about this" — you ask in your own words, the query is embedded, and the closest chunks come
back with their session and snippet.
It is a drop-in replacement for the official backend: both extend the same `sessionQuery` service, s
o exactly one of them may be mounted at a time.
## Requirements

| DSH | `0.2.1-rc.2` (developed and tested against it) |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `~4.0.5` |
| `@de

epseek-ai/schemastery` | `3.18.5` (ships with DSH) |
| Node.js | 22+ — the indexer uses the built-in

`node:sqlite` (`DatabaseSync`) |
| An embedding endpoint | Ollama locally, or any OpenAI-compatible

:sqlite` (`DatabaseSync`) |
| An embedding endpoint | Ollama locally, or any OpenAI-compatible API |
Earlier DSH releases are untested.
## Two pieces
| Piece | What it is |
| `lib/index.js` | The **query** side — a `SessionQueryEngine` subclass mounted as a plugin. Answers

searches by reading the index. Never embeds. |
| `indexer.mjs` | The **index** side — a standalone
script. Walks `~/.dsh/sessions`, embeds the message text, writes the vectors. |
They are deliberately separate: search must stay fast, and embedding is slow. The query side never t
riggers an embedding on the search path; if the index is empty it returns nothing.
**The two sides must use the same embedding model.** Otherwise the stored vectors and the query vect
or live in different spaces and every score is noise. Configure `embedModel` identically in both.

## Endpoint contracts

### OpenAI-compatible (`provider: openai`)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Response: `{ "data": [{ "index": 0, "embedding": [...] }, ...] }`. Results are sorted by `data[].ind
ex` before use — some providers return them out of order.
A trailing `/v1` on `baseUrl` is stripped before `/v1/embeddings` is appended, so `https://api.silic
onflow.cn/v1` does not become `/v1/v1/embeddings`.
Any endpoint that satisfies this contract works: SiliconFlow, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Together, a loca
l vLLM or LM Studio server, and so on. Set `baseUrl`, `apiKey` and `embedModel` to whatever that pro
vider names the model.
## Building the index
`indexer.mjs` is not run by DSH — start it yourself, after the query side is configured. It must be
able to `import` the `@deepseek-ai/*` packages, so run it with the DSH runtime (see below).

| `DSH_HOME` | `~/.dsh` | DSH home. Everything else derives from it. |
| `DSH_MODULES` | `$DSH_HOME/
node_modules/@deepseek-ai` | Where to resolve `@deepseek-ai/*`. Override for the packaged desktop ap

| `VEC_DB` | `$DSH_HOME/storages/session-query-vector.sqlite` | Index path — must equal the plu

gin's `path`. |
| `VEC_SESSIONS` | `$DSH_HOME/sessions` | Session log root. |
| `VEC_PROVIDER` | `ol

lama` | `ollama` or `openai` — must equal the plugin's `provider`. |
| `VEC_BASE_URL` | `http://127.

0.0.1:11434` | Must equal the plugin's `baseUrl`. |
| `VEC_API_KEY` | `""` | Must equal the plugin's

`apiKey`. |
| `VEC_MODEL` | `bge-m3` | Must equal the plugin's `embedModel`. |
| `VEC_CHUNK` | `120

0` | Characters per chunk. |
| `VEC_BATCH` | `16` | Chunks per embedding request. |
| `VEC_SUBAGENTS
` | — | Set to `1` to include subagent sessions. |
